elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return, with written certification
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing
for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates (exceeds 90 days)
within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format

reasons: The inserted 10.3 supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: transition assistance on expiry or termination, a 6-month maximum, then-current rates, 30-day return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance; the mandatory 30-day data return and the deletion/certification duties are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the return obligation.
The 30-day clock runs from expiry or termination 'of this Agreement', so continuing Order Forms do not prematurely trigger exit duties — consistent with the deterministic precision checks.

Minimal: a single concise new subsection was added to an agreement that contained no exit/data-return mechanic; existing 10.1, 10.2 and 16.5 are untouched and remain effective, and the qualifiers 'reasonable' and 'at Customer's request' are ordinary scoping rather than a rewrite or new broad exception.
Intent preserved: no undefined terms are introduced (Customer Data, Vendor, Agreement are defined), and 16.5's cross-reference issue is left as-is rather than being disturbed.
